core_job: A ledger the user keeps by hand, plus their recurring income, bills and subscriptions, all stored on the phone. It answers one question: what is free to spend until the next payday without a bill bouncing? It keeps the balance true without retyping recurring items. The user is someone paid weekly, fortnightly or monthly who will not link a bank.
signature: "Until Payday", computed in pure Dart (runway.dart, occurrences.dart) from on-device SQLite. The user adds an income schedule with weekly, biweekly, monthly or yearly repeats. From that, the app works out the day-by-day balance to the day before payday and the lowest point it reaches, with the date and the item that causes it. "Free" is the lowest point minus a buffer the user sets; "a day" is free divided by the days left; if the lowest point falls below the buffer, the app says "Short by X on <date> after <item>". A "Did these happen?" queue lists each scheduled bill once its date arrives. Paid posts it to the ledger in a single SQLite write, and it can never be posted twice. "Different amount" posts the real amount and records the subscription's price history. Competitors were checked only through their App Store descriptions, using the keyless iTunes Search/Lookup API (WebSearch is disabled in this session): - PocketGuard is built around connecting a bank and costs $12.99/mo. - Foreseenly and Stay Above forecast but mention no ledger or budgets. - Kualto needs an account and a subscription. - Money Manager and Bobby mention no forecast.
